title: Steve Movie Painting
body:
This is a collection of resourcepacks, each of which replaces one existing painting with a new one — "Steve." It's based on a real painting by Kristoffer Zetterstrand, dedicated to the film "A Minecraft Sequel".

They replacing:
- Donkey Kong — 3x4
- Skeleton — 3x4
- Pigscene — 4x4 with **light** painting frame
- Pointer — 4x4 with **light** painting frame
- Burning Skull — 4x4 with **dark** painting frame
- Orb — 4x4 with **dark** painting frame
- Unpacked — 4x4 with **dark** painting frame
